description: This file defines the MemoryDrawing class, which manages in-memory image data within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for creating, cloning, and handling image resources, as well as identifying image types and rendering formats.

classes.name: MemoryDrawing
classes.description: A class representing an in-memory image resource, supporting conversion from streams and strings, cloning, and rendering image data for use within spreadsheets.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new MemoryDrawing object with default rendering and mime type settings.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destroys the image resource to free memory upon object destruction.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the MemoryDrawing object, including cloning the image resource.

methods.name: cloneResource
methods.description: Internal method to clone the image resource, handling transparency and color information.

methods.name: fromStream
methods.description: Creates a MemoryDrawing object from a stream resource containing image data.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a MemoryDrawing object from a string containing image data.

methods.name: identifyRenderingFunction
methods.description: Determines the appropriate rendering function based on the mime type.

methods.name: identifyMimeType
methods.description: Identifies the mime type of image data using temporary files and possible exif or GD functions.

methods.name: identifyMimeTypeUsingExif
methods.description: Uses exif_imagetype to determine mime type if available.

methods.name: identifyMimeTypeUsingGd
methods.description: Uses getimagesize to determine mime type if available.

methods.name: supportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Checks if a mime type is supported by this class.

methods.name: setImageResource
methods.description: Sets the image resource and updates width and height.

methods.name: getIndexedFilename
methods.description: Returns a filename based on the unique name and image index.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the current object state.
